name: Great curtained bed
description: The four-post bed of a great merchant house: a plank tester with blind tracery and dark green woollen curtains tied back at the posts over feather beds and a red coverlet.

visual.look: Oak four-post bed with a tracery-edged tester, dark green wool curtains tied back with cords, white linen and a deep red coverlet.
